title: What is actually in the box
subtitle: Everything below is built from scratch - no headless CMS SDK, no admin panel generator.

items.title: Universal content layer
items.description: A single Content entity - title, subtitle, description, customData, media, key, order - backs every section of every page. Adding a section means picking a new key, not writing a model, an API and an admin form.

items.title: customData as the escape hatch
items.description: A JSONB column holds anything a section needs: CTA buttons, tag lists, stat rows, nested objects, feature flags. Extending a block never requires a schema migration.

items.title: Rich text and JSON editing
items.description: Tiptap for description fields with a sanitizing paste pipeline, plus a validating JSON editor for customData - so structured content stays structured even when edited by hand.

items.title: Media pipeline
items.description: Uploads land in MinIO with rollback on failure, drag-and-drop reordering on desktop and directional buttons on mobile, and permanent public URLs that browsers can cache.

items.title: Auth and access control
items.description: Google OAuth2, dual JWT with access and refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies, refresh-token rotation in the database, and role-based guards - editing is gated behind the admin role.

items.title: ISR and on-demand revalidation
items.description: Content is fetched with Next.js cache tags, so saving a block revalidates only the pages that consume that key. Static performance, live editing, no rebuild.
